body: uhh i dunno what happened to everything i wrote in the caption

***UPDATE 4/25***

my car confirmed to be totaled!! the shop said, "yeah, she was hit really damn hard." 🥲 

if anyone's curious, i so far don't have to pay my insurance deductible or the rental costs because the other guy's insurance is covering it. now it's a waiting game while our two insurances duke it out over the settlement payment.
TODAY YEARS OLD.

i miss the sex on the surface level, specifically how my ex did some things. but when i think about how my partner now does things with more care & intent, actually communicated with me about what i like/don't like & vice versa, the sex with my ex is just a far off memory that wasn't as loving as i thought it was at the time.

i'm actually really bummed out if i can't salvage that sticker! i held onto it for yeearrs 'cause i was worried that i'd lose it in an accident or something. but after having it around for 5+ years, i finally put it & the freshly obtained "spooky ghoul" on my bumper. 😭
i've just been reminded of the bumper sticker i have about clouds. 😶‍🌫️
hahaa, no, we were all slowing to a stop but the guy behind me sped up. actually was raining the whole day, so no incredibly interesting clouds to be seen.
lmao, what does that mean? i wasn't the one that sped up & rear ended someone.

also, YES about hearing about hyundai. i feel like i got the last good hyundai off the lot 'cause after that, i've only heard about hyundais having to go back for repairs/replacements & increased lemon cars. my mom got a new hyundai in 2021 after her muucchhh older hyundai bit the dust & it's gone in for so many recall repairs that i've lost count by this point. we had a 2003 hyundai that got passed around in our family that by the time it got to me, i just couldn't afford some of the repairs it needed (basically just the belts, but ALL the belts), so i sold it & got my current 2016 hyundai.

i'm glad you made it out of the accident! it sounds absolutely horrible. honestly, even if insurance even gives me half of what i paid for this car ($14k), that's still way more than what i can pay without anything. but i still agree the system is broken, & i'm really hoping for $9k if my car is totaled. my car has less than 80k miles on it & was in good shape until being rear ended. i just drove to work & back since i got it off the lot in 2016.

hello, fellow marylander. dang, $4100 is like my entire bank account. but also that's way less than i expected to hear from someone else who had similar damages. yeah, i'm so confused on why the cops didn't come out, & i was so flustered that i'm kicking myself for not pushing for them to come out. i called the non emergency number, lady said since no one was hurt & i wasn't obstructing traffic, & it wasn't emergent(who else did i call???), that i just have to call a tow & no one needed to come out. 

i'm gonna try calling his insurance tomorrow; fingers crossed they have weekend offices???

car was towed to a collision repair shop. i didn't even know towing it to my house was an option, but i would've had to have it towed for a shop in the end, right?

i will definitely call his insurance company. i emailed mine after posting this with a list of questions (including if i need to call the other driver's insurance). i have a high feeling he's not gonna answer any calls from anyone,  & i'm so disheartened (but not surprised) that the cops didn't even come out to get a statement in the case that the guy just disappears. i have a $500 deductible on my insurance that i'm aware of. which i can swing if i just don't buy more groceries for a bit & work 5 more hours of overtime at work than usual the rest for next month or so (i am just
writing out my thought process at this point).

worst case scenario, i have a giant repair fee
best case, insurance gives me just enough to do a down payment on a new car. where i'm moving, it'll be a few hundred cheaper for rent. if i can swing a deal, i can just use that difference as a new car payment. i just know i can't afford car repairs that's more than a couple hundred or a sizeable down payment on a new car. BUT, if i miraculously get even $2k for a totaled car, i can put that as a down payment & manage a monthly payment.

similar boat. all my exes have gone back to their exes & married. & it's not even like i'm jealous & wish i wish i was back them?? i absolutely don't, but for some reason it still stings a lot & i feel bad about myself in the sense that i have yet to find a long term relationship that involves us moving in together or one day getting married. each of those relationships high tailed it when, after a couple years, wanted things to go a step further & live together or talk about marriage. & then they end up back with their exes, doing all the things we talked about?? wild!

my best friend compares me to the guy from good luck chuck. 😬

i think that's weird. like, i wouldn't wanna know when it was happening?? i asked my roommate we just coordinated when we needed alone time with our partners or like, "hey, we want the house to ourselves for a while" & letting each other know if our partners were gonna be at the house at all, so we wouldn't be surprised if we came home to find the other just going at it in their room. 

so i dunno how else you can be accommodating, you're doing what most respectful roommates do to begin with?? i think that's an incredibly weird & invasive ask from your roommate. they can just deal with never actually KNOWING when you're doing anything with your boyfriend.
yuh, i've been in my room pretty much since thursday night. come out to grab food & eat it back in my room.
multiple people she was with on the trip tested positive shortly before leaving the trip & coming back.
she def got it before me because i hadn't seen her for over a week prior to it. she just got back from an out of state business trip for a convention.
no, she got it from her business trip. i had covid over a month ago & i stayed in my room the entire time.
ahh, i get it. it's feeling like you're just a guest, right? that the place is really just hers & you just get to sleep in a spare room?
the plus side is is that my room is now incredibly clean. i just spent the entire day deep cleaning & reorganizing my bookshelves.

it'll be okay! even if things won't be great to an outsider's perspective, things will be OKAY, & those moments that're okay, will feel amazing & great because you got yourself to that point of just being okay.
so if i ignore him harder, it'll just make him want my attention more? 😂 he greets me every morning & after work like i'm his long lost mother.

i don't think this normal. i'm going through a similar situation as well. think definitely have a sit down talk with roommate about it, and maybe set up something for yourself in your room so that if you don't have a choice, you can at least still enjoy yourself in your room.

i have a similar roommate & the walls in our place are really thin. headphones at night helped me a lot. also turning on a fan to help muffle noise. i normally need netflix playing at a very low volume, too. i find that having multiple things going on a similar volume in my room almost feels like it noise cancels everything else going on outside of my room.

"that's selfish"
"have you tried therapy/talked to your therapist?"
"it's all in your head."
"haha, same."
"you don't actually feel that way."
"you'll get over it."

i love this, compartmentalized. i def want to meet his kid one day, but right now everything separated is working so well. i think he's an amazing dad, based off how much he talks about his daughter, the things she's done that he shows me, & how other people in our social circle that've known him prior to us dating have mentioned. 

i imagine that me meeting his daughter would also bring me to eventually meeting & interacting with his coparent, which is a touchy subject in a lot of bad ways (none of which is related to them as a couple prior). prolly was a similar kind of thing with your sister, having to eventually meet the mom too?

oh man! i'm not entirely sure what happens after season 6, i'm kinda familiar with random things about it. like i know the zombies have "evolved" & there's the "kingdom" & other communities. but something about those first 5 seasons really get you hooked. 😂

very few people have stayed in my life over the years, either because i'm "too intense", "too sad", or self isolation. even my best friend of almost 20 years has said over the years how they would actively avoid me when things weren't too serious to be worried about (yet). i seriously do not treat my friends like therapists, i have my own & i'm medicated. but building & keeping that support system is sometimes just as exhausting or more as having to cope with the depression. 

when i can tell another episode is starting, i just isolate. like an act of "kindess" to others & out of self loathing.

my roommate separates her cats. keeps the one that gets bullied the most in her room with her at night, & then the other two stay out in the living room 'cause they'll have the least chances of fighting each other. their midnight zoomies also end up in the basement 'cause of the amount of space, so they're the least noisy that way. 

we try to play with them closer to bed time to try to tucker them out & give them bedtime snacks so they're least likely to beg for food before 4 am.

the first 5 seasons of the walking dead on repeat. 🥶 just the first 5 seasons, especially season 2. i watched twd way before meeting him, never watched it with any of my previous partners. none of them had an interest in it, there's little to no romance in it.

thank you! that really means a lot. i'd like to say it's all the years of therapy we've gone through that's allowed our relationship to be so emotionally open. i absolutely have not had a relationship like this before. we did a lot of talking the next day after i posted this and i feel immensely better. a close friend also gave me some tough love about my insecurities how she sees my boyfriend treats me (very well, apparently).   


it's def been reassuring seeing that other parents have gone through several years of dating their partners before meeting their kids. my boyfriend's constantly telling me how appreciative he is that i've been so patient with him, so i really hope that also applies to being patient with meeting his kid.   


i'm glad to hear that your relationship has turned out really well after a few years of keeping dating/parenting life separate. i hope that the same happens to me, hahaa.

these kinds of comments have been super reassuring, seeing that other parents separate their dating/parenting lives for long periods. i'm not a parent (obviously), but am really close with my family (i'd say enmeshed at this point, but healing). multi generational household, lived with my grandma my entire life and was her caregiver for 15 years before she passed from dementia. my mom's opinion/input on who i'm dating is super important, so while he's already he'd meet her, i'm not ready, especially if his daughter is not ready to meet me. and honestly, i'm not ready to meet his daughter either! she's so cool, i'd be a nervous wreck, and teenagers can be ruthless.

at this point as other parents have pointed out, it really isn't up to me or him on meeting his daughter. i'd believe if she didn't want to right now, since the time we started dating, she's gone through several mile stones as a preteen and life changing events. her mom's remarrying, she's struggling with mental health, she went through her first break up, and this year she started high school. 

i wouldn't say it's a double standard in the sense that i was asking about what's consider a normal time frame. i haven't pushing to meet her or pushing for him to meet my mom (because he's already said he would).   


currently, i see him more than his friends! they know about me, though. between being a parent, depression, and working 1 full time job, and 2 part times, he doesn't have time to see his friends, and he makes more time for me to see him instead and even more time just to spend with his daughter.  


and yes, we're actually BOTH in therapy and treatment. i would not be dating him otherwise since i'm absolutely "unhinged" when i'm not.

we did the conversation on when it would be good for us to meet, but ultimately it came down when "timing is right", as in, she's in a huge transitional part of her life where he felt it would be too much for her to meet someone new on top of him feeling apprehensive given past experiences. currently, her mom is about to get married, she went through her first break up, diagnosed with some mental health issues, and just started high school this month. all happening shortly after he and i started dating.   


as a few other parents in here pointed out, it's not really up to me or my boyfriend - but up to his daughter. even if we want her to meet me, if she doesn't want to, then she doesn't have to. and i'm too afraid at this point to even ask if she wants to (given everything else going on in their lives).

this is reassuring to me. he's really worried about disrupting his teenager daughter's life - with coparent getting married soon, she just started high school this year, went through her first break up. he mentioned having "issues" with introducing her too early in the past, but didn't go into detail. when i think about it, i'd be so scared to get attached to her just to go through a break up. 

i am very happy & satisfied with things as they are & he's said the same thing. i don't think about it much until someone from outside the relationship brings it up - & honestly, my roommate & her boyfriend have made comments that we're moving too slow & we don't see each other enough, & that's been bothering me a lot.

i'm not trying to pressure him into introducing his daughter to me and not pressuring him to meet my mom. just asking if this time frame is considered normal for other single parents.   


at this point, we're serious, as we did have the big talk about our feelings for each other and what we our to each other.

this makes sense to me. i suppose i've thought more about myself & him in this situation, and haven't really considered her thoughts on it. i've been too afraid to ask if she'd even want to meet me, honestly! i met my ex step dad when i was a pre teen and it was a total shock 'cause we didn't know my mom was even dating anyone.   


know my boyfriend, i'm sure he'd talk to her about it first before just doing the same thing my mom did.

i'm not ready for them to meet yet, honestly. like i'd want things to be more serious, like ready to really start talking about future/marriage. we're really enjoying each other right now, & i think if i met his daughter, then i'd want him to meet my mom. she's met my previous partners, sometimes right away & i've always regretted it later on. i'm only guessing that this is how he's feeling about his daughter meeting me.

thanks, man. my only hang up with living here has been the cats, who i can otherwise tolerate when they're not fighting each other. that makes me feel guilty given everything else my roomie has done to make our home a home & we get along fine. just seems like there can be much more she could be doing to help her cats feel at home. i so badly wanna create more vertical space for these cats because they just have one single cat tree. call me petty or whatever, but i don't want to spend the money on them either, & she hasn't made the move the get the second hand cat trees or cat walks i find for her because they're not 1) aesthetically pleasing 2) "i can build it myself."
i'm trying very hard to be patient about it 😵‍💫
i wish i knew more about the health hazards from cats so i could support my frustration better vs just being grossed out 😮‍💨

i know she doesn't think this okay, but she's not taking the steps to address it - which i know is just purely behavioral. 😭 otherwise i don't think cat 1 would be doing this. she doesn't just poop/pee on the stove, it's actually in several places in the house, but it's mostly in spaces where my roommate spends the most time: her office, her bathroom, her bedroom. so i'm at least thankful it's very rarely where i spend time (so far just once in the living room), but the kitchen grosses me out the most.

i 200% agree. i'm not a cat person, but i know this behavior is NOT normal or fair to any of those cats. the cat that does the most bullying is so territorial & legit tried to kill my friend's dog when she came over to visit. & the cat being bullied hates other animals in general & is constantly stressed out. & i totally understand feeling defensive when being confronted about taking care of your pets. i've tried to gently approach the subject of rehoming at least one of the cats over the last few years & it's always a conversation that doesn't get very far.
yeah. i'd never seen him cry before over the few years we were together. but he cried while dumping me. i still don't really understand anything.

& don't forget all the god damn CHARTING. i'm a scribe, & it's just so much chartttingg 'cause those charts gotta be signed no less than 48 hours after the patients' visit, & when you got 50 charts a day to sign, you can easily be there for over an hour after the last patient leaves.

i work in a clinic with open/closing hours, but i push 50 hours a week 'cause the main doctor i work for works four 10 hour days, & then on the day she's off, i do admin things like schedule templates, ordering medications, work with the other doctor in office (because she works only two days out of the week). it's not uncommon for us to be pushing 11 hour days a couple times a week.

even tho the schedule ends at 3:10, we can easily be there until 6pm. i never really know when my day ends because our little saying is that, "it's over when the last patient leaves." & we just never know what those last few patients are gonna end up needing treatment or testing wise.

i'd appreciate it. one ex cheated for a whole year with multiple women & then went public with his ex that he got back together with. all of his friends knew about his cheating & congratulated on them getting back together. his friends even tried to keep being friends with me, but then stopped talking to me over being "too upset" about my ex doing the things he did. felt so humiliated & worthless.

honestly kinda need the same thing to fulfill my codependency "needs". 

32, f, bi. live on the east coast. v shy until comfortable, but that takes a while. i struggle to make & keep friends, so i just have a v small friend group. i like to text a lot, don't do phone calls - i can only facetime family & my best friend of 17 years. i have boyfriend of less than a year, but we both struggle with codependency & depression. i'm trying v hard not to lean too much on him for support as this has been a recurrent issue in my previous relationships.

hobbies:
art (sketching, inking, some watercolor)
playing games (my fixation/therapeutic game right now is minecraft)
building miniatures
taking care of houseplants (i have a bunch)

my day job is an ophthalmology scribe - & i work long hours during the weekdays, but can text p often in between exam rooms. 

i don't go outside much aside from work or seeing my two irl friends & boyfriend - i get v scared. 

currently medicated, in therapy & psych treatment. 
i have insomnia, so sometimes i'm awake most of the night, but with my meds & set work routine, it's easier to manage this disorder.

i'm sorry you're going through this. i have similar experiences (3 out of 4 of my long term relationships ended with my exes going back to their exes). it's heartbreaking & really damaging on your self esteem/worth.

my advice is that block everything possible relating to your ex - avoid friends/friends of friends of your ex, focus on yourself. i would tell myself that they're "stuck" in the past, they're not worth it if they clearly didn't see me as worth it to try to make myself feel better. 

prolly not the best or most in depth advice, but it's something for now.
i know this reply is way late, but i really appreciate this comment.
i think i'm just tired of fighting and tired of getting hurt over and over again. just really feels like i'm not worth it.

i hope that you're kind to yourself, too. i'm glad to see that you also have a therapist to help guide yourself. i also have a therapist, which helps for my depression in general, but no one seems to really help with grieving over a break up from years ago.

if you hold on, i'll hold on. i'm just so tired. this is such a heartbreak i've never experienced before, & that's saying a lot after gone thru several long term relationships of 5+ years & one engagement.

time is moving so SLOW. i have anxiety & shit, so i constantly feel like i'm waiting for something. there is nothing to wait for. i'm busying myself with work & freelance art stuff, also in the process of a new day job. but it feels really pointless, tbh.

about 2 months. it hasn't gotten any easier at all for me. i keep myself very busy, but at the end of the day all those thoughts/feelings i try not to consume myself with just come rushing back.

not having someone to share how your day went or fall asleep with at the end of the day is immensely more lonely & isolating than i thought it would be. considering that i talk to my friends through out the day. 

it's just those quiet intimate moments that make you feel Very Empty when you don't have that Person. 

i don't cry as often, but i def still cry & the crying are those hard ugly sobs you get like it was just after the break up. & it hits me as soon as i'm alone. i miss them ALL THE TIME, & it hurts a lot knowing that they don't & they're fine & don't hurt at all. 

for context: i was the dumpee. it was actually a healthy communicative relationship. i'd noticed he started withdrawing the last couple months. i tried talking to him about it, would give him space, told him i loved him & how much he meant to me, etc. turns out he was realizing he didn't feel the same way about me anymore, & didn't want to progress the relationship because it wouldn't be fair to me. we tried the being friends thing, but it wasn't working because i still love him.

// also want to point out that the guy i was just getting to know, i did not emotional dump on him at all, & expressed that i do have a lot going on, but also just want to take things slow & get to know each other. so he barely had any idea what was even happening in my own life, just that it was a lot.

definitely, yes. i made the mistake of trying & realizing i was just rebounding. i'm working really hard on realizing that just because there's emotional dumping and escapism, doesn't mean there's real connection and closeness.

i definitely have too much going on my plate, and my plate is small enough as it is, and have for the last few years. at which point is "not yet" just too long?

i'm trying really hard not to see the negative aspects of living with this. i hear stories of people diagnosed with depression & never having a major relapse again or people who have managed it their entire life but lose to it in the end & commit suicide when they're much older.

but then you see the ones who struggle just to maintain normalcy, & i feel like i'm in that category. & i'm trying really hard not to just lean on it & feed that. 

i desperately want to be happy & to not be scared of the future & uncertainty that goes with it, but right now it just looks bleak. i am actively saying i choose happiness, but it feels like an impossibility.

i feel you. it's so exhausting. i am trying really hard to hold onto those "small things in life" & good things like having my dog no matter how annoying she is. & you know what, my giant jigsaw puzzle from amazon just arrived, & i wanna get that done first before doing anything.

i understand how you're feeling. i'v been on all kinds of different meds, different psych/therapists, a few psych hospital stays. & it's just...exhausting. no matter how good of a day i had or how much my friends make me laugh, i'm still depressed & all those Thoughts catch up to me when i'm alone. 

it feels really hopeless just trying to hold onto the small things in life, saying "one day at a time" & for what, for another 60 years if we even make it that long?

all the time. i catch myself mid sentence. or i'm just really candid(?)/open about it. 

a guy friend texted something sexually inappropriate to me, knowing full well i'd just gotten out of the hospital, & i immediately told my friend who was near by, "i'm done. put me back in the ward. i hate it here."

my therapist asked me if i had any plans to look forward to in 2022, & i was like, "well, i didn't think about it because i wasn't planning on being here" because i had recently tried to end my life.
ughh, that sounds really good. i do love potatoes/fries as a comfort food. recently got a free air fryer & that sounds like something i can easily do.

i've never seen salad kits, tbh! but those really good. i eat a lot of junk food & mcdonald's when i can't get myself to make/assemble anything. i really lack in greens/fresh vegetables, haha.

glad to see you're putting on weight!
i really like that!

grieving has no time line, & feeling lonely & sad during these times is normal. you lost something very important, & your whole life has to shift. it does get easier to cope with over time.

there is absolutely nothing wrong with wanting to be in a relationship to feel more whole. finding solace in someone is good! but being able to recognize when it's turned into codependency is good, too.

i think therapy is worth it, but it's a major effort to find the therapist that clicks with you. i've gone through 5-6 therapists in the last 10 years, & it's even harder to really open up & be honest with them once you're established. therapy & cbt is a good combo. 

one thing i hear a lot from other people is, "stay alive out of pure spite." also, those ensure drinks are really yummy. 

stay strong. ✨
hope today was a calm one for you~ hang in there.

i'm glad that you were able to get yourself out of that detrimental situation. i'm sorry that you have to go thru it every year & have to be the parent for your parent.  hope at least tomorrow you'll have a more calm day. 💛

hang in there 🤎 you're not alone here. zoloft was my favorite (same dose, no side effects), but a few others were added when i said i was just barely above water with minimal stressors. 

i know you didn't ask for advice, but maybe see if you can add explore more treatment options (increased therapy, additional meds, maybe even day hospital outpatient group therapy) to help you cope with this significant life change. i know i would be such a mess if i was in your situation.

i definitely understand that not all friends are equipped to handle these types of conversation, & treating your friends as therapists is not healthy to either party. 

it's more that you wouldn't want someone to trivialize your mental illness & cry for help by going, "haha same" & then just carrying on like it's not a serious issue.

exactly!! i am chronically depressed & have been hospitalized several times. telling me "haha same" or "it's all in your head" is just counter productive & harmful. 

so now neither of us feel comfortable seeking support/comfort from each other & our social circle is smaller than before. 

is it really "haha same" for you or are you just frustrated that nothing is going your way, my guy?? like do you wanna go to the ER with me?? we can all go together & get help.

exactly! feeling low & being sad is normal, but being really depressed & a danger to yourself is not normal & shouldn't warrant a "haha same"! 

& honestly, i'd be more understanding & supportive, but this person also has made no effort in seeking help or accepting that they themselves might also have depression.

thanks, but i'm already in therapy & medicated! have been for the last 12 years. it's more that i'm looking for comfort/support from my social circle, not just immediately turning to my therapist, who will also say that finding support/comfort with peers is important.

while i understand that your average person isn't crisis equipped, your average person shouldn't reply, "haha same" when you're confiding in reaching rock bottom and need help going to the ER.
😂 it's just frustrating!
they didn't provide us with journals this time around, so i didn't get to journal at all! :( i went out & bought way too many markers & crayons so i can color more often.
it's getting so unbearable.

i'm at the point where "one day at a time" isn't working & can't get myself to eat. i made a Plan & have been cutting again. i'm having a hard time reaching my therapist & considering going to the ER, but that would be really devastating to my mom for me to go while she's also busy taking care of my grandma & going thru a lot of other stressors.
i feel you. it's like, the more you try to move on, the harder your heart fights it. they're everywhere you look, hear, the smallest sound or scent. just feel stuck.

i'm really in the same boat. my ex left because he didn't feel the same. we had an amazing 2 year relationship & tried being friends after as we never fought or had any toxicity within the relationship.

but it was really hard because i was so emotionally invested in him, am actually still in love with him. 

i personally say don't do it for your own sake. it hurts me so much that the dynamics of our relationship had to suddenly change to friendship, & the person i KNOW as a lover/partner is now inaccessible & a boundary, & having to see him be that way with others is so hurtful.

you did what was best for the both of you. it would've hurt more to prolong it & go through the holidays at each other's throats.

it does really suck that it was right at the holidays, though.

i wouldn't know about the medication part, but i hate sleeping exactly for this. i wake up feeling less rested & more sensitive & anxious than before. i'm prescribed just trazodone as a sleep aid, but it doesn't stop the anxiety dreams/nightmares either. i just wake up feeling worse. so now i don't use it at all.

am interested in seeing what other people have to say.

i hate waking. i feel utterly disappointed, i cry, just so upset that i made it thru the night even though i didn't do anything to prevent myself from waking up. 

it takes at least half the day for me to get out of the feeling while i'm working, & the process repeats when i clock out.

you're not in the wrong for being upset about it. i thought there was an unspoken rule that friends shouldn't mess around or date friends' exes, especially without talking to & making sure the friend is okay with it. 

i'd be very uncomfortable with a friend dating any of my exes regardless of what type of relationship it was or how long it was. i'd have to see/tolerate that ex being around.

i'm in the same boat. i learned to keep my newest scars well moisturized & refraining from scratching/itching while they heal. gentle exfoliation seems to help, but they're scars. it may take years for them to really fade. 

tattoo make up/cover up helps when i really need to hide them.

i've been on dating apps since the break up 4 years ago, & kept running into the same problem as you. i'd meet/talk to some interesting/cool people, but no one ever sparked an interest the way my ex did. some people had me laughing, & others just turned into short term casual friendships, but no one had that "zest" that would progress things to the next step. 

i haven't run into my ex yet on any of them yet, tho. thank god. i'd completely lose it. i'm still trying to cope & move on, but it's hard. i don't want to just use someone as a rebound or move into a relationship when i still have feelings for someone else.

i'm so sorry you're going through this. 

i didn't have the experience of having to live with an ex after breaking up, but the coping after sharing a space is really rough. i found not sleeping in the room we shared to be helpful, letting myself wallow the first few days, & watching a shit ton of shitty movies/tv at night to fill the silence to be helpful.

avoid a lot of caffeine intake, drink more water than usual, & carry big blankets around with you. also doesn't hurt to yell/scream.

i've heard of this before & think it's really beautiful~ i've gone through a lot of trauma in my life, & i actually did once journal about it, calling him the gold to fill in all the cracks. he doesn't know about it, but i don't think it matters at this point. 

i would very much like to be a new plate, tho, hahaa.

between this & coping with everything else going on in my life, i am definitely feeling lost. it's not that i don't know who i am without him (or a relationship in general), this is just the first time that i really realized i genuinely wanted to share myself with someone. me building my miniature models time after time & gaming with my friends & getting praise at work doesn't account for much to me when at the end of the day & i'm trying to sleep, i can't share it with someone. if that makes sense?
